q: State the chromosome number in a human sperm cell.
Complete the gamete numbers for dog and rice.
Explain why gametes must have half the number of chromosomes.
At fertilisation two gametes join; halving keeps the chromosome number the same each generation (23 + 23 = 46).
A student says more chromosomes means a more complex species. Use the data to evaluate this.
Not supported: dogs (78) have more than humans (46), and rice (24) has more than fruit flies (8) but rice is a plant. Chromosome number does not show complexity.
